title: Cardinal Alessandrino to the nuncio in Spain, 1567 (ASV SdS Spagna 1; catalogue 261)

steps.what: Fetched DECODE records R85-R90, their transcriptions and key files, and two page images, with the repository cookie.
Found Lasry's reconstructed key on every record, byte-identical to the key on R93-R102 (alessandrino1568); no plaintext attached.
Identified sender, recipient and year from the archive description on the records (ff. 146-338 = Alessandrino to the nuncio, 1567) and the clear openings on ff. 163r, 299r.
Tried archive.org and HathiTrust for Serrano 1914; not on archive.org, HathiTrust 403.
Ran the alessandrino1568 decoder unchanged on the six transcriptions.

All six read as continuous Italian: Philip II's journey to Flanders and a papal interview, Borromeo's Milan jurisdiction, the archbishop of Cologne, the second French civil war; R88/R89 are two copies of one letter and R90 repeats its close.

Historical consistency: Morvilliers, l'Aubespine, Montmorency, Conde and Coligny in arms date R88-R90 to Oct-Nov 1567; Cologne (von Wied, unconfirmed) and the Milan dispute fit 1567; the two copies R88/R89 agree.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): DECODE transcriptions (RebAn 2016) per record; decryptions = the word-split DECODE bodies from decode_updates/decryptions copied into texts/, plus decrypt_raw.txt, all with Lasry's key as filed (decode/DOC_R85_D3265_3265.txt etc.).

Reading audit (George Lasry's test: can a reader build coherent sentences and translate them?). texts/R85-R90_decryption.txt and decrypt_raw.txt read: Italian fragments between garbled strings in nearly every line in all six letters (R85, R87, R89 closely), e.g. 'pur tu giudica che saria bene che re inuita sectabolo oposi satisfatione del mondosi'; docs/_check_reading.py 21-40% of sentences clean in the word-split files. All six relabelled decoded, not read; class read -> not read, method read with known key -> not solved (key kept as a part); fraction_read unknown -> 0.

Re-read under REREAD_BRIEF (batch b09): the 10 DECODE cipher images of R85-R90 and their 29 cleartext images (folios around each cipher) fetched with the DECODE session cookie (research/reading_audit/b09_fetch.py), kept out of the repository.

Contemporary texts looked for among the cleartext images: R87's decipherment is f. 251r (top lines lost, stops at "resistere"); R90's second sentence is in clear on f. 302r (end of the 4 Nov 1567 letter with R88); R88, R89, R90 are three cipher copies of one text. No decipherment for R85, R86, R88, R89 (clear covering letters only). Serrano 1914 not reached (HathiTrust 403).

Decipherment f. 251r and clear passage f. 302r transcribed from the images (texts/R87_decifrato_f251r.txt, R90_clear_f302r.txt). Cipher transcriptions checked on the images at every break: twelve labels corrected (texts/R85-R90_corrections.tsv; corrected files for R85, R86, R87), e.g. R86 row 1 2020 -> 1010 (N.S.) and 4 0 2 0 9 -> 4 0 1 0 9 0 (a V.S.), R85 row 2 four spurious figures removed.

Decipherment of R87 aligned with the figures (reread_b09_align.py, edit-distance DP over the two-letter figure sets) and R88/R89/R90 aligned with each other and with f. 302r. Code values fixed: 8010 = [la] Regina [di Francia] (Lasry "Re di Francia"), 4010 = S.M. (Lasry "Sua Santità"), 1020 essere, 1040 lettera, 8030 religione, 8070 ugonotta, 8080 heretici, 8090 havere, 3040 Fiandra; 3 0^. 9 = qua; "colospo" = colloquio (colo + 509 qui + o); 209 = "chi" as a syllable (richiesti). The decipherer misread in four places, where the figures are followed.

All six read word by word on the figures from a first draft by the extended beam decoder (reread_b09_decode.py --rows), every word aligned with its figures (research/reading_audit/b09_align.py: R85 169/190, R86 155/164, R87 437/448, R88 326/361, R89 336/349, R90 45/48 words carried); words not carried bracketed. English translations written. _check_reading.py on the reading bodies: 1.00, 1.00, 1.00, 0.93, 0.92, 1.00 clean. Failed or open: R85 codes 3050 and 3020 (this use), a blotted group and a ticked run; R86 code 2020; R88 group 7 3 8. State decoded, not read -> read for all six; class not read -> read, method not solved -> read with known key.

outcome.method_basis: George Lasry's 2020 reconstructed key was attached to every DECODE record R85-R90 before the attempt; it is polyphonic (each digit two letters, zero a null). The beam search under it gave fragments only. On 22 Oct 2026 the contemporary decipherment of R87 (f. 251r, a DECODE cleartext image) was transcribed and aligned with the figures, and the three cipher copies of the 4 Nov 1567 letter (R88, R89, R90, with the clear sentence on f. 302r) were read against each other; they fixed the code values (8010 Regina [di Francia], 4010 S.M., 1020 essere, 1040 lettera, 8030 religione, 8070 ugonotta, 8080 heretici, 8090 havere), with which all six were read word by word on the figures, twelve transcription labels corrected on the images.
outcome.notes: R85-R90 read word by word on the figures with Lasry's key as extended by the R87 decipherment (f. 251r) and the three copies R88/R89/R90; holes marked in texts/R8x_reading.md (codes 3050, 3020 in R85, 2020 in R86; a few partly carried words). 22 Oct 2026: reading audit decoded, not read; same day re-read (batch b09, texts/R85-R90_reread_log.md) and class back to read. Serrano 1914 not reached (HathiTrust 403, not on archive.org).

texts.label: R85, Spagna 1 item 1, f. 165r [1567]
texts.summary: Rome, 8 Jan 1567: the Pope wants to know whether the King's journey will go ahead, because he would then meet him wherever suits him; the Queen Mother and the King of France wish Philip to invite them to a parley; the Pope distrusts "words of women" but urges the King to admit, even seek, the meeting, leaving it to his prudence, and offers to act as common father.

reading_review.note: No decipherment or print found; read word by word on the figures with the key as extended by the R87 decipherment and the R88-R90 copies, eight transcription labels corrected on the image (texts/R85_transcription_corrected.txt); 169 of 190 words carried (b09_align.py), the rest dotted zeros the transcription lost or bracketed. Holes: codes 3050, 3020 (this use), one blotted group, one ticked run.

texts.label: R86, Spagna 1 item 2, f. 236r [1567]
texts.summary: Rome, 25 July - 2 Aug 1567, Milan jurisdiction case: the Pope means, in confidence, to proceed with spiritual arms against the authors of the outrage, above all the Senate; the governor is to make them obey the monitories; the Holy See's dignity requires action at least against the Capitano di giustizia, the fiscal and some senators; the King should deprive his two ministers of office.

reading_review.note: No decipherment or print found; read word by word on the figures, three labels corrected on the image (texts/R86_transcription_corrected.txt; row 1 "di N.S., per dirlo a V.S."); 155 of 164 words carried. Open: code 2020, "[?quel] fatto", "[?havere]" (8090), "[?via]".

texts.label: R87, Spagna 1 item 3, ff. 249r-250r [1567]
texts.summary: About 2 Aug 1567: the Pope wants the King to go to Flanders soon, to restore religion there, in France and Germany; the Queen Mother of France wishes to be invited to a meeting, which the King should grant; the archbishop-elect of Cologne, unconfirmed and allied with the Duke of Cleves, is to be deprived, and the King should see that the chapter does not choose a suspect successor.

reading_review.note: Contemporary decipherment on f. 251r of the same file (texts/R87_decifrato_f251r.txt; its top lines lost, it stops at "resistere") transcribed and aligned with the figures: 437 of 448 words carried; figures followed where they differ (dal qual, ma perché, esso pretenso arcivescovo, o dependente). The last four rows rest on the figures alone.

texts.label: R88, Spagna 1 item 4, f. 301r-v [autumn 1567]
texts.summary: Rome, 4 Nov 1567, a chapter of a letter from France passed on to the nuncio: the Queen Mother is timid, trusts the Chancellor, Morvillier, Limoges and l'Aubespine, and keeps the kingdom divided to rule; not a Huguenot but a bad Christian; if the King imprisoned the Constable and his son until Condé and the Admiral laid down arms, the troubles would end.

reading_review.note: No decipherment; read word by word on the figures (326 of 361 words carried), the damaged figures (rows 10-17 of each page) read from R89, a second cipher copy of the same text. Covering letter in clear, Rome 4 Nov 1567 (ff. 299r-302r). One group (7 3 8) unread.

texts.label: R89, Spagna 1 item 5, f. 314r-v [autumn 1567]
texts.summary: Second copy of the R88 text (the chapter of a letter on the Queen Mother and the French court), ending "da persona molto bene", continued in R90.

reading_review.note: No decipherment; read word by word on the figures (336 of 349 words carried) and against R88, the other cipher copy, and R90, which continues it; the R87 decipherment fixes the codes (8010 Regina, 4010 S.M.).

texts.label: R90, Spagna 1 item 6, f. 324r [autumn 1567]
texts.summary: End of the same text: the writer is well informed of the French court and the Queen Mother; the King should let the Queen know that her counsellors, unfaithful to God, will be little faithful to her.

reading_review.note: Read on the figures (45 of 48 words carried); it continues R89 word for word and its second sentence is written in clear on f. 302r of the R88 copy of the letter (texts/R90_clear_f302r.txt).

parts.label: R85-R90 (Lasry's key, extended by the R87 decipherment and the R88-R90 copies)
parts.basis: Lasry's key (24 Oct 2020) extended on 22 Oct 2026 from the contemporary decipherment of R87 (f. 251r) and the three copies of the 4 Nov 1567 cipher; read word by word on the figures with the images checked at every break (texts/R85-R90_reread_log.md).

outcome.fraction_read_source: 22 Oct 2026, reading audit: no letter builds sentences, so nothing counts as read (0). No earlier figure had been measured (fraction_read was 'unknown'); NOTES' 'all six read end to end' is withdrawn. 22 Oct 2026, re-read (batch b09): all six letters labelled decoded, not read now build sentences and are translated (texts/R85-R90_reading.md, _en.md; _check_reading.py on the reading bodies 1.00, 1.00, 1.00, 0.93, 0.92, 1.00 clean). Items of letters that read / all items = 1.0 (every record R85-R90). Open inside the readings: codes 3050, 3020 (R85), 2020 (R86), about ten partly carried or unread words.
